raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the date format from Wikipedia. "11 September 1962" was incorrectly “standardized” to MM/DD as 11/09/1962 (November 9, 1962) instead of the correct 09/11/1962 (September 11, 1962). This day/month inversion was then propagated in subsequent instructions, directly leading to an incorrect birth date for the performer.
